description: This file defines the 'FloorDivBinary' class, which implements a binary expression for floor division in Twig's expression syntax. It extends an abstract binary class and provides methods to compile the operation into PHP code, specifically casting the floor division result to an integer.

classes.name: Twig\Node\Expression\Binary\FloorDivBinary
classes.description: A class representing floor division binary operation in Twig's expression language, compiling to PHP code that performs floor division with casting to int.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the floor division operation by generating PHP code that performs floor division and casts the result to an integer.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns the operator symbol '/' as raw PHP code.
